title: Ignoring travel vaccines can be risky - expert warns ahead of trips to South Asia
description: Dr Farhat Malik, a senior doctor with over a decade of experience in Australia, specialises in treating patients from South Asian backgrounds. He says many travellers make a crucial mistake — they overlook getting vaccinated before flying to countries like Pakistan or India.

title: Karanbir Singh smashes T20I record for most runs in calendar year; overtakes Suryakumar and Rizwan with 1488 runs
description: In a landmark achievement for associate-nation cricket, Karanbir Singh of the Austria national cricket team has smashed the men's T20 International calendar-year runs record, overtaking the figures of Pakistan's Mohammad Rizwan and India's Suryakumar Yadav.

title: Pakistan Will Think Twice Before Attempting Any Misadventure With India, Says Rajnath Singh
description: While interacting with soldiers in Jaisalmer's Barakhana, Rajnath Singh said Operation Sindoor was still on and warned Pakistan of a harsher response in case of any misadventure.

title: Operation Sindoor: India's Strategic Show of Strength
description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh highlighted India's Operation Sindoor as a significant warning to Pakistan, emphasizing military vigilance and preparedness. He reiterated that the operation showcased India's capabilities and served as a deterrent against future misadventures. Singh also emphasized the military's pivotal role in India's national development goals.

title: Operation Sindoor: Showcasing India's Naval Dominance
description: Operation Sindoor highlighted the Indian Navy's deterrent capabilities, keeping Pakistan's forces restrained. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh lauded the Navy's combat readiness and strategic deployment in the Indian Ocean Region, emphasizing India's role as a significant maritime force. The operation also showcased India's commitment to self-reliance through indigenous equipment.

title: Punjab Kingpin Who Retrieved Drugs Dropped By Cross-Border Drones Arrested
description: In a major breakthrough against cross-border drug smuggling, the Punjab Police have busted a narcotics trafficking module operating along the India-Pakistan border.

title: India, the Quad and the fallout from the Saudi-Pakistan defense pact
description: THE Pakistan-Saudi Arabia Mutual Defense Pact signed on Sept. 17 has fundamentally altered the regional balance of power in the Middle East and South Asia. Unlike previous agreements, this one goes far beyond symbolic cooperation. Pakistani officials have openly said that the pact extends Riyadh access to its deterrence capabilities in the event of aggression. For decades, Gulf monarchies had relied on the United States as their ultimate security guarantor. Now, with doubts over Washington’s reliability and growing regional rivalries, they are diversifying their options.
